caption: The drawing depicts an object consisting of a handle and a wire loop attachment. The handle is elongated, cylindrical, and appears to be made of a brown material, possibly wood, with a smooth surface. Attached to the top of the handle is a narrow metal collar, possibly brass, connecting it to several thin, twisted metal rods that extend upward. These rods then separate and form a star-shaped wire loop at the top, with the wire bent in a continuous, angular pattern resembling multiple protruding arms or zigzags. The wire is metal and dark in color, creating a distinctive contrast with the lighter brown handle. The background is plain and light, allowing the object to stand out clearly.
title: Toaster
